Build it.

You are the Lead Engineer. Make verified progress on ONE checklist item per cycle.

Available tools:
- write_file: Write a file. (args: {'path': {'type': 'string'}, 'content': {'type': 'string', 'description': 'it\'s "new"'}})

- noop: No arguments. (args: {})

You act by replying with EXACTLY ONE JSON object and nothing else.
To use a tool: {"tool": "<name>", "arguments": { ... }}
When the item is fully done: {"done": true, "summary": "<what you did>"}
Take one action per reply. Prefer reading/searching before writing.
Signalling done does NOT mark the item done: the harness then runs the deterministic checks, and only a green result counts. Do not edit files under .lha/ (harness-owned) and do not modify or delete existing tests or test configuration.
As soon as this item's acceptance checks pass, signal done instead of running more tests: if the harness's checks then fail, you get the failure report while turns remain.

Active checklist item: [01] Add the model

Mission: M

You are the Lead Engineer. Make verified progress on ONE checklist item per cycle.

Available tools:
- write_file: Write a file. (args: {'path': {'type': 'string'}, 'content': {'type': 'string', 'description': 'it\'s "new"'}})
- run: Run argv. (args: {'argv': {'type': 'array', 'items': {'type': 'string'}, 'minItems': 1}, 'timeout_s': {'type': 'number', 'default': 60.0, 'maximum': 1e+16}, 'check': {'type': 'boolean', 'default': True, 'nullable': None}})
- noop: No arguments. (args: {})

You act by replying with EXACTLY ONE JSON object and nothing else.
To use a tool: {"tool": "<name>", "arguments": { ... }}
When the item is fully done: {"done": true, "summary": "<what you did>"}
Take one action per reply. Prefer reading/searching before writing.
Signalling done does NOT mark the item done: the harness then runs the deterministic checks, and only a green result counts. Do not edit files under .lha/ (harness-owned) and do not modify or delete existing tests or test configuration.
As soon as this item's acceptance checks pass, signal done instead of running more tests: if the harness's checks then fail, you get the failure report while turns remain.

Active checklist item: [02.1] Wire the API

This item is done only when ALL of these acceptance checks (witnesses) pass, in addition to the mission's checks:
- go:TestAPI@./internal/... (run: go test -count=1 -run '^TestAPI$' -v ./internal/...)
- cmd:make check (run: make check)

messages.content:
Mission: M

You are the Lead Engineer. Make verified progress on ONE checklist item per cycle.

Available tools:
- write_file: Write a file. (args: {'path': {'type': 'string'}, 'content': {'type': 'string', 'description': 'it\'s "new"'}})
- run: Run argv. (args: {'argv': {'type': 'array', 'items': {'type': 'string'}, 'minItems': 1}, 'timeout_s': {'type': 'number', 'default': 60.0, 'maximum': 1e+16}, 'check': {'type': 'boolean', 'default': True, 'nullable': None}})
- noop: No arguments. (args: {})

You act by replying with EXACTLY ONE JSON object and nothing else.
To use a tool: {"tool": "<name>", "arguments": { ... }}
When the item is fully done: {"done": true, "summary": "<what you did>"}
Take one action per reply. Prefer reading/searching before writing.
Signalling done does NOT mark the item done: the harness then runs the deterministic checks, and only a green result counts. Do not edit files under .lha/ (harness-owned) and do not modify or delete existing tests or test configuration.
As soon as this item's acceptance checks pass, signal done instead of running more tests: if the harness's checks then fail, you get the failure report while turns remain.

Active checklist item: [01] Add the model

specs.name: read_file
specs.description: Read a UTF-8 text file at a path relative to the workspace root.

specs.name: write_file
specs.description: Create or overwrite a UTF-8 text file (path relative to the workspace root).

specs.name: edit_file
specs.description: Replace one exact snippet in a UTF-8 text file (path relative to the workspace root). 'old_text' must appear exactly once: copy it from read_file with enough lines to be unique. Prefer this to write_file for changing an existing file.

specs.name: list_files
specs.description: List files under the workspace (optionally a subdirectory), ignoring noise.

specs.name: grep
specs.description: Search file contents; returns path:line: text matches. 'pattern' is a literal string unless 'regex' is true (simple regular expressions only).

specs.name: run_command
specs.description: Run a command (argv list, NO shell) in the workspace; returns output + exit code.

specs.name: record_decision
specs.description: Record a design decision that later work must stay consistent with (an interface, data format, library choice, naming rule...). It is committed with this cycle's checkpoint to the mission's append-only, hash-chained decision log and shown to every later cycle. Record the decision, why, what you rejected, and affected files.

Prefer this to write_file for changing an existing file. (args: {'path': {'type': 'string'}, 'old_text': {'type': 'string'}, 'new_text': {'type': 'string'}})

- run_command: Run a command (argv list, NO shell) in the workspace; returns output + exit code. (args: {'argv': {'type': 'array', 'items': {'type': 'string'}}, 'timeout_s': {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': 1}})
- record_decision: Record a design decision that later work must stay consistent with (an interface, data format, library choice, naming rule...).
